original_chart.notes: Small brown agaricoid, cap with deeper brown central depression; pale cream-buff lamellae; pale stipe; no persistent ring/volva visible; basal debris but attachment substrate uncertain.

field_addendum.pileus: Tan to cinnamon brown, broadly convex to nearly plane; moist/glossy-looking, smooth to very finely fibrillose; thin slightly irregular margin.
field_addendum.hymenophore: Pale cream to buff, moderately spaced lamellae with lamellulae and occasional branching; described as broadly adnate to short-decurrent in field views. Earlier detached specimen assessment could not confirm attachment.
field_addendum.stipe: Pale cream to tan, slender, longitudinally fibrillose, slightly curved, ochraceous/brownish staining; base not intact.
field_addendum.habitat: Deciduous forest floor with leaf litter and decomposing wood in context; precise substrate attachment unconfirmed.

historical_microscopy.recorded_interpretation: Globose to subglobose spore-like structures with some broadly ellipsoid views; hyaline/weakly refractile and apparently smooth-walled. Mature spore identity and diagnostic anatomy not independently confirmed.
